metrics.name: Purchasing users
metrics.numerator: Distinct valid users with purchase events
metrics.caveat: North-star candidate; browser IDs are not people. Daily counts are not additive across dates.

metrics.name: Session conversion
metrics.caveat: Includes purchases without valid transaction IDs; not an ordered funnel rate.

metrics.name: Checkout completion
metrics.sql: SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(purchase_ts IS NOT NULL),COUNTIF(checkout_ts IS NOT NULL))
metrics.exclusions: Missing earlier stages and equal-time transitions
metrics.caveat: Conservative observable sequence; instrumentation gaps may resemble dropoff.

metrics.name: Revenue per active user
metrics.exclusions: Invalid or conflicting transaction IDs; missing USD not imputed
metrics.caveat: Revenue includes transactions without valid users. Withhold decision use if missing revenue or identity coverage is material.

metrics.name: Average order value
metrics.caveat: Incomplete if any transaction revenue is missing; gross purchase value, not net refunds.

metrics.name: Exact-day retention
metrics.numerator: Eligible users active on exact day N
metrics.denominator: Users with N complete days available
metrics.caveat: First observation is not acquisition or signup. Historical left censoring remains.

metrics.name: Funnel inputs
metrics.numerator: Sessions with product view / cart / checkout events
metrics.caveat: Unordered presence inputs differ from ordered funnel stage counts.

metrics.name: Transaction rate
metrics.numerator: Deduplicated transactions linked to valid sessions
metrics.caveat: Can exceed one; do not label as conversion probability.

experiment.status: Prospective design; no experiment was run
experiment.product_change: Clarify availability and the add-to-cart action on product pages.
experiment.decision: Investigate the largest observed ordered-session dropoff; user-level power planning uses a separately aligned eligibility baseline.

findings.title: Largest drop-off: product view to cart
findings.evidence: 14,380 of 77,020 eligible sessions progressed; 81.3% did not. End-to-end completion was 3.6%.
findings.interpretation: This is the largest proportional loss in the observable sequence; it is not proof of avoidable UX friction.
findings.action: Clarify availability and the add-to-cart action on product pages. Validate event order before testing.
findings.boundary: Descriptive sequence, not a causal effect.

findings.title: Device checkout comparison
findings.interpretation: Wilson intervals and eligible counts are available in the aggregate download.
findings.action: Do not prioritize mobile checkout based on an assumed deficit; test the larger observed funnel bottleneck first.
findings.boundary: Exploratory association; multiple segment comparisons are not confirmatory tests.

findings.title: A real conversion change on 2021-01-22
findings.evidence: Session conversion was 2.18%, versus 0.76% across prior matched weekdays. Device mix contributed -0.001 pp; within-device rates +1.417 pp.
findings.interpretation: The change remains visible against the two most recent matched weekdays; the full baseline includes holiday dates.
findings.action: Review changes in traffic quality, product demand and instrumentation across devices. Do not attribute the change to a release without independent evidence.
findings.boundary: Descriptive decomposition; no product incident or causal explanation is established.

findings.title: Return on the seventh day
findings.evidence: 1,966 of 250,712 eligible first-observed users returned on exact D7 (0.8%).
findings.interpretation: This is browser-level return behavior, not signup retention.
findings.action: Compare mature cohorts and first-session behavior before planning retention interventions.
findings.boundary: No claim that carting or purchasing causes return.

findings.title: A testable next product decision
findings.evidence: The eligible-user baseline is 16.44%. A 10% relative MDE requires 8,293 users per arm at 80% power (~28 days), or 11,102 at 90% (~35 days).
findings.interpretation: Duration uses observed eligible traffic and full weeks; holiday seasonality limits forecasts.
findings.action: Clarify availability and the add-to-cart action on product pages. Randomize users with persistent assignment.
findings.boundary: Prospective design at two-sided 5% alpha and 50/50 allocation; no treatment result.

investigation.status: Descriptive investigation; neither cause nor outage established.
